Notes ka maksad har cheez yaad rakhna nahi hota. Maksad hai apne future self ke liye chhote breadcrumbs chhodna.

Complex folders, coloured tags, aur daily review ke baad mera ek rule bacha: jab koi baat mujhe rok de, use ek sentence me likh do.

- Tailor ke radio par commentary machine se zyada tez thi.
- Ek achha question, galat answer se zyada useful ho sakta hai.
- Rain ke baad sheher ka colour thoda neecha ho jata hai.

Do hafton baad notes padho. Jo lines ab bhi zinda lagti hain, unhe expand karo. Baaki ko chhod do. Notes museum nahi, compost hain.

[[Sheher ko paidal padhna]] observation deta hai; [[Bore hone ki kala]] woh khaali jagah jahan observation paida hoti hai.
